full_prompt_en: The square image is a richly ornamented digital painting of a large peacock whose long neck extends horizontally toward the right among oversized flowers. Its rounded body and sweeping tail occupy the left and lower portions, covered in rows of vivid eye-spotted feathers. Each feather carries concentric rings of turquoise, teal, indigo, magenta, orange and gold, with dark outlines separating the repeated eyes. The neck emerges from the central mass and curves toward the right, its surface layered in bands of green, blue and purple scales. The small head sits near a bright flower at the right, with a short beak and a sharply outlined eye. Large blossoms fill the centre and upper right, their petals formed from broad overlapping strokes of coral, pale yellow, pink, cream and orange. Smaller circular flowers and rosette-like motifs fill the remaining gaps. Across the background, curling ribbons and spiral bands of turquoise, violet, red-orange and gold weave around the bird and flowers, leaving almost no empty ground. The surface is highly textured, with fine dots, loops, short dashes and repeated curved lines packed into the colour fields. Darker blue and purple areas define the feather layers, while bright turquoise and gold accents pick out the eye patterns and flower centres. The lighting is even and decorative rather than naturalistic; colour contrast creates the sense of depth, and small highlights sit along the raised curves. The composition is dense but organized around the bird’s sweeping horizontal neck and the fan of tail feathers below. The tail feathers overlap in long curved layers, each eye spot nested inside bands of contrasting colour. Some feather tips curl inward toward the centre, while others stretch toward the lower-left edge. The neck forms a smoother counter-curve across the busier pattern, making its direction toward the right easy to follow. Petals vary from broad, pale forms near the centre to smaller bright rosettes near the upper corners. Their edges are outlined and ornamented with dots, rings and short dashes, so the eye moves continuously between the larger shapes and the finer marks. Tiny circular marks and short curved strokes repeat between the larger bands, filling the remaining gaps. Dark outlines define the feather eyes and the layered petal edges. The overall image balances a central bloom with the peacock’s patterned plumage, combining jewel-like colour, intricate linework and continuous ornamental movement across the square frame.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、装饰极为繁复的数字绘画：一只大型孔雀在巨大的花朵之间伸展，长颈朝右横向延出。它圆润的身体和弧形尾羽占据左侧与下方，羽毛上排列着一行行鲜艳眼斑。每根羽毛都带有青绿、绿松石色、靛蓝、洋红、橙色与金色构成的同心环，深色轮廓将重复眼斑彼此分开。脖颈从中央体块伸出，向右弯曲，表面叠着绿色、蓝色和紫色鳞片状色带。小小的头部停在右侧一朵亮色花旁，可见短喙与轮廓清楚的眼睛。中央与右上方布满大型花朵，花瓣由珊瑚色、浅黄、粉色、奶油白和橙色的宽阔叠笔构成。更小的圆花与玫瑰花结状纹样填满剩余空隙。青绿、紫色、红橙和金色旋卷带与螺旋纹在孔雀和花朵周围交织，几乎没有留下空白底面。表面纹理十分密集，色块中挤满细点、环线、短划和重复弧线。较深蓝紫区域界定羽片层次，明亮青绿与金色强调眼斑和花心。光线均匀而装饰化，并不写实；色彩对比建立空间，细小高光沿着凸起曲线分布。构图繁密却围绕孔雀向右横伸的脖颈及下方扇展尾羽组织。尾羽以长弧形层层叠压，每个眼斑都嵌在对比鲜明的色带之中。有些羽尖向中央内卷，另一些则伸向左下边缘。颈部以较平滑的反向弧线穿过更繁密的纹样，使其向右延伸的方向容易追随。花瓣从中央附近宽阔浅色形状，变化到上方两角较小而鲜亮的玫瑰结形。花瓣边缘饰有圆点、环线和短划，视线因此能在大形与细痕之间持续移动。细小圆点和短弧线在较宽色带之间反复出现，填满剩余空隙。深色轮廓勾出羽毛眼斑和层叠花瓣边缘。整体画面以中央花朵平衡孔雀纹样丰富的羽毛，在方形画幅中结合宝石般色彩、精细线描与连续装饰动势。
style_prompt_en: The digital painting uses saturated jewel tones, dense linework and continuous ornamental movement. Curved bands, concentric marks and small repeated motifs fill most of the surface, while dark outlines separate overlapping colour regions. Turquoise, indigo, violet, coral, pink, yellow and gold create strong chromatic contrast. Forms remain legible through contour and value shifts even when pattern density is high. Light is expressed through small highlights along curves rather than realistic cast shadows. The overall treatment is exuberant and intricate, balancing dense decoration with a clear sweeping direction across the frame.
style_prompt_zh: 数字绘画采用高饱和宝石色、密集线描和连续装饰动势。弯曲色带、同心纹与重复小图案填满大部分表面，深色轮廓则分开相互叠压的色区。青绿、靛蓝、紫色、珊瑚色、粉色、黄色与金色形成强烈色彩对比。即便纹样十分密集，形体仍通过轮廓和明度变化保持可辨。光线以沿弧线分布的小高光表现，而非写实投影。整体处理热烈而繁复，在密集装饰与清楚的横向流动方向之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Jewel-coloured peacock sweeping through oversized flowers and ornamental spirals
theme_zh: 巨花与装饰旋纹间流展的宝石色孔雀
name: Elena Kotliarker
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
